title: PollEngine
description: Empower your community with customizable polls!
body:
PollsEngine - Advanced Polling System for Your Server
Requires GUIEngine
Engage your community with interactive and customizable polls!

️ Available Commands:
• /poll create "<question>" <duration> <option1> <option2> [option3...] – Create a new poll.
• /poll vote – Vote in an active poll using a graphical interface.
• /poll info – View the details and current results.
• /poll cancel – Cancel an active poll.
• /poll help – Display help with all available commands.

✨ Key Features:
• Create polls with multiple options.
• Voting system with an intuitive GUI.
• Timer for automatic poll closure.
• Detailed results with winning option.
• Configurable permissions support.
• Fully customizable messages.
